clue.text: Announce politician in real time

indicators.note: the politician sits inside the word for real, split between its third and fourth letters

parts.note: real means true
MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A newsreader reporting a politician's arrival live, as it happens.
explanation.definitionFit: To trumpet something is to proclaim it loudly, a synonym for announcing it.

clue.text: Leading hotel on a budget finally getting suitable cover

parts.note: top means leading or foremost
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word budget

explanation.surface: A smart hotel run cheaply getting the right insurance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cover' looks like insurance, but it is a hat; 'suitable' suggests the formal wear.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall formal hat is headwear, a cover for the head fit for weddings.

clue.text: University on Jersey, say, has one area that's heaven

parts.note: a jersey is an example of a top, a garment
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A university on the island of Jersey with one blissful area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jersey' looks like the Channel Island, but it is a garment, a top; 'say' marks an example.
explanation.definitionFit: An imagined perfect place, so a kind of paradise on earth.

clue.text: A Parisian's foothold in the property market?

definitions.text: A Parisian's foothold in the property market?

parts.words: A Parisian's foothold in the property market?
parts.note: the French phrase means literally foot on ground, a Parisian's foothold; in English it is a small second home, a foothold in property

explanation.surface: A French buyer getting a first foot on the housing ladder.
explanation.definitionFit: A small flat or house kept for occasional use, literally French for foot on earth.

clue.text: Manage to find tense people

parts.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
a race is a people

explanation.surface: Succeeding in locating some anxious people.
explanation.definitionFit: To track down or discover after searching is to locate, that is to succeed in finding.

clue.text: Take great pleasure in hugging one rescuer

indicators.note: the relish word wraps its arms round the single figure, holding it inside

parts.note: to savour something is to take great pleasure in it
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone delighting in embracing the person who saved them.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: one who saves or delivers others from danger is a rescuer.

clue.text: Boots may have these singular tools to protect delicate material

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

indicators.note: the garden tools surround the fabric, shielding it within

parts.note: hoes are garden tools
lace is a delicate fabric

explanation.surface: Gardening boots and tools protecting fine fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Laced footwear is fastened with strings, so boots carry them.

clue.text: Struggle on with attitude

parts.note: to vie is to struggle or compete

explanation.surface: Battling on with a stubborn manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a point of view is an outlook or opinion, one's attitude.

clue.text: Composition old soldiers put in proportion

indicators.note: the soldiers are placed inside the word for proportion

parts.note: a ratio is a proportion
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Veterans being placed in proportion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old soldiers' reads as veterans, but 'old' and 'soldiers' each give their own piece; OR is other ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: A large-scale sacred musical work for voices and orchestra, a musical composition.

clue.text: Engineers condescend to accept second new plan

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers of the British Army

indicators.note: the word for condescend takes the letter for second inside it

parts.note: to deign is to condescend

explanation.surface: Engineers grudgingly agreeing to a second, fresh plan.
explanation.walkthrough: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, a fresh layout or design for something, hence a new plan.

clue.text: Adjectives — or pronouns — will hold back such writing

indicators.note: back tells us the held letters are read from right to left
the words of grammar contain the letters within them, spanning the word break

explanation.surface: A grammar point: parts of speech holding back a certain style of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will hold' finds ESORP across 'adjectivES OR Pronouns'; 'back' turns it round. 'Such writing' refers to the clue's own words: adjectives and pronouns are what ordinary written language is made of.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinary written language, not verse, is the kind of writing built from adjectives and pronouns.

clue.text: Bad idea so far, as previously mentioned

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters are put into a poor, disordered state and so rearranged

explanation.surface: A verdict that a plan has been a poor one up to now.
explanation.definitionFit: Legalese adjective meaning said or named earlier in the same document.

clue.text: Time any lad exercised with spirit

indicators.note: exercised suggests the letters are put through their paces and moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A coach timing a boy as he works out energetically.
explanation.definitionFit: Adverb sense: done in a lively, spirited way, full of energy.

clue.text: Troubles coming as result of enemies having leader replaced with women?

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for enemies is swapped out for the letter standing for women

parts.note: enemies are foes
W is the standard abbreviation for women, as on toilet doors

explanation.surface: Wondering whether one's troubles stem from rivals being led by women.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun: griefs and misfortunes, synonyms for troubles.

clue.text: Enormous bother tabloid raised on trade union article

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the letters are read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to nag is to bother
a rag is a disparaging word for a tabloid newspaper
AN is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A big row about a tabloid publishing a story about a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns NAGRAG upwards into GARGAN; 'on' places it above the rest in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after Rabelais's giant, the word means huge or gigantic.

clue.text: Disapproving of accepting Independent losing value

indicators.note: the disapproving word takes in the single letter, which slots inside it

parts.note: deprecating means expressing disapproval of
I is the abbreviation for Independent, as in an election candidate

explanation.surface: Someone frowning on taking in an independent candidate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disapproving' and the answer differ by a single letter in spelling but are quite different in meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: Participle sense: an asset falling in worth over time is depreciating.

clue.text: A rare drug distributed as a means of defence

indicators.note: distributed suggests the letters are spread around and dealt out in a new order

explanation.surface: An unusual medicine handed out to protect people.
explanation.definitionFit: The troops guarding the back of an army, so a means of defending it.

clue.text: Creature that's a sort mostly protected by benefit

indicators.note: the shortened word for sort is sheltered inside the word for benefit

parts.note: a plus is a benefit or advantage

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a type is a sort or kind

explanation.surface: An animal that is a kind of thing guarded by welfare money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the last letter of TYPE, leaving TYP.
explanation.definitionFit: The duck-billed egg-laying mammal of Australia is an example of a creature.

clue.text: Germany united to underpin surplus and exaggerated

indicators.note: in a down clue the second part sits below the first, supporting it

parts.note: over means in excess, surplus
D is the international vehicle code for Germany
one means united, as in at one

explanation.surface: A unified Germany shoring up an excess, which is a bit much.
explanation.definitionFit: Overacted or carried too far, so exaggerated or overplayed.

clue.text: As a rule, veg is cooked for this dish

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are prepared and reworked into something new, fitting the kitchen setting

explanation.surface: A culinary observation that vegetables are normally cooked for a certain dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface implies a vegetable dish, but the answer is a meaty spread. LIVER SAUSAGE is a soft sausage made from liver, often spread on bread.
explanation.definitionFit: A liver sausage is a specific item of food, so a dish served at the table.

clue.text: In truth, rivers do well

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the words that follow, spanning the gap

explanation.surface: A claim that rivers really do flourish.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to flourish or prosper is to do well.

clue.text: Agreement may be dispatched after airports vacated

indicators.note: after puts the dispatched word behind the emptied airports
vacated means the word is emptied out, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: sent means dispatched

explanation.surface: A deal may be posted once airports have emptied.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: assent is consent or agreement to a proposal.

clue.text: Source of nutrient on salt lake

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the nutrient's letter is placed after the sailor

parts.note: a salt is an old sailor, also known as a tar

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it begins, its opening letter

explanation.surface: Nutrients feeding a salt lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Salt lake' reads as one phrase, but 'salt' is a sailor and 'lake' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A small mountain lake, especially one in a hollow carved by a glacier.

clue.text: Plant article to fill a space like this

indicators.note: the article goes into the opening, plugging the gap between the space and the phrase like this

parts.note: a gap is a space
thus means in this way, like this
AN is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Advice to place something in a gap in this way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a space' looks like one piece but 'a' and 'space' each give letters, with 'to fill' putting the article between them and 'like this'.
explanation.definitionFit: The African lily, a flowering garden plant with blue or white blooms.

clue.text: Gather statement from defendant not without denial

parts.note: a plea is a defendant's statement of guilty or not guilty

indicators.note: without tells us the denial is taken away from the word not

parts.note: no is a denial

explanation.surface: Collecting a defendant's statement that does not include a denial.
explanation.definitionFit: In sewing, a fold of fabric is a gather, so a pleat is a gather.

clue.text: Iron originally included in standard brace

indicators.note: the opening letter goes inside the word for standard

parts.note: par is the standard, as in golf

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter of the word iron

explanation.surface: A golfer's iron included as standard in a set of two.
explanation.definitionFit: A brace is two of something, especially game birds, a couple.

clue.text: A way in after support spread

indicators.note: after tells us the way in comes behind the support in the answer

parts.note: a prop is a support
a gate is a way in, an entrance

explanation.surface: An entrance found behind a support that has been spread.
explanation.definitionFit: To propagate ideas or plants is to spread or multiply them.

clue.text: Join European attached to small military force

indicators.note: the letter is fastened onto the end of the military force

parts.note: a unit is a small body of troops

explanation.surface: A European soldier joining a small military force.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bring together or combine is to join.

clue.text: Cut listener being introduced to cast

indicators.note: the listener goes into the word for cast, sitting inside it

parts.note: to shed is to cast off, as a snake its skin
an ear is the organ that listens

explanation.surface: A theatre scene: a listener cut after being introduced to the cast.
explanation.definitionFit: To shear is to cut with blades, so the past form means cut.

clue.text: A touching line from bronze chap

parts.note: a bronze is a tan colour, as of sunburnt skin
a chap is a gent

explanation.surface: A sweet, moving remark from a sun-bronzed man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching line' suggests a moving remark, but in geometry it is a line touching a curve at one point.
explanation.definitionFit: Geometry term: a straight line meeting a curve at exactly one point.
